# Pipeline Overview & Input Data Requirements

This notebook provides an end-to-end, reproducible differential abundance analysis pipeline for label-free quantitative proteomics (DIA/DDA) using **limma** and **DEqMS** (variance shrinkage weighted by quantified peptide/precursor counts).

To run this pipeline on your dataset, place your input files in the `data/` directory and configure the paths and parameters in **Section 1**.

---

### Required Input Files & Format Specifications

#### 1. Protein Quantification Matrix (`FILE_INTENSITY`)
- **Software Source**: Standard output from mass spectrometry search & quantification platforms such as **Spectronaut** (e.g., Protein Report, `directLFQ` matrix), **DIA-NN** (`report.pg_matrix.tsv` or `pg_matrix.tsv`), **MaxQuant** (`proteinGroups.txt`), or **FragPipe** (`combined_protein.tsv`).
- **File Format**: Tab-separated (`.tsv`) or comma-separated (`.csv`).
- **Structure**:
  - **First Column**: Unique Protein Identifiers (e.g., UniProt Accessions like `P04637`, gene symbols, or protein group IDs).
  - **Remaining Columns**: Numerical abundance or intensity values (raw or normalized LFQ / MS2 intensities) across runs/samples.
  - **Zeroes & Missing Data**: Unquantified values or zeroes (`0`) are automatically converted to `NA`.
  - **Column Headers**: Sample column headers should correspond to the sample identifiers in the metadata table (common prefixes such as `[1] ` or suffixes like `.raw` / `.mzML` are automatically cleaned during ingestion).

#### 2. Sample Metadata Table (`FILE_METADATA`)
- **File Format**: CSV (`.csv`) or TSV (`.tsv`).
- **Structure & Columns**:
  - `Sample_Name`: Unique sample identifiers matching the sample columns in the protein intensity matrix.
  - **Primary Grouping Column** (e.g., `Group`, `Condition`, `Treatment`): Factor variable indicating the biological condition or experimental group for each sample (e.g. `Control`, `Treated_A`, `Treated_B`). If your experiment has multiple factorial variables (such as genotype and exposure), combine them into a single `Group` column or configure `PARAM_GROUP_COL`.
  - `Replicate` (Optional): Identifier for biological or technical replicates (e.g., `1`, `2`, `01`, `02`). If technical duplicates or repeated measures are present, configuring `PARAM_BLOCK_COL = "Replicate"` enables `limma::duplicateCorrelation` to model intra-replicate correlation.
  - **Covariates** (Optional): Additional columns (e.g., `Batch`, `Sex`, `Cohort`) available for cohort subsetting (`PARAM_SUBSET_COL`).
- **Example Metadata Layout**:

| Sample_Name | Group | Replicate | Batch |
|:------------|:------|:----------|:------|
| Sample_01   | WT_Control | Rep1 | 1 |
| Sample_02   | WT_Control | Rep2 | 1 |
| Sample_03   | WT_Treated | Rep1 | 1 |
| Sample_04   | WT_Treated | Rep2 | 1 |
| Sample_05   | KO_Control | Rep1 | 2 |
| Sample_06   | KO_Treated | Rep1 | 2 |

#### 3. Peptide / Precursor Count Table (`FILE_PEPTIDES`)
- **Software Source**: Must be extracted from the **exact same search/quantification run** as the protein intensity matrix (e.g., Spectronaut peptide/precursor summary report, DIA-NN precursor count matrix, or MaxQuant peptide evidence count).
- **File Format**: Tab-separated (`.tsv`) or comma-separated (`.csv`).
- **Structure**:
  - **First Column**: Protein IDs matching those in the protein intensity matrix.
  - **Remaining Columns**: Number of quantified peptides or precursor ions identified per protein per sample/run.
- **Role in DEqMS**: `DEqMS` (`spectraCounteBayes`) fits a variance-dependence curve on the number of quantified peptides/precursors. Proteins quantified by many peptides receive stronger variance shrinkage, improving statistical power while controlling false discoveries.
- **Graceful Fallback**: If a peptide count file is omitted or unavailable, the pipeline defaults to equal weighting (`count = 1`), behaving identically to standard `limma::eBayes`.

---

# 1. Pipeline Configuration & Setup

Modify the paths and parameters in this block to run this pipeline on any new dataset.

```{r}
#| label: setup-and-config

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(limma)
  library(DEqMS)
  library(openxlsx)
  library(purrr)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Directory Path Resolution
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
proj_root    <- if (dir.exists("data")) "." else if (dir.exists("../data")) ".." else "."
path_data    <- file.path(proj_root, "data")
path_results <- file.path(proj_root, "results")
path_figs    <- file.path(proj_root, "figures")

dir.create(path_results, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(path_figs, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Input File Paths (Update these for a new dataset)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata CSV/TSV file
FILE_METADATA <- file.path(path_data, "Proteomics_metadata.csv")
if (!file.exists(FILE_METADATA)) {
  cand_meta <- list.files(path_data, pattern = "(metadata|sample.*info).*\\.(csv|tsv)$", ignore.case = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(cand_meta) > 0) FILE_METADATA <- cand_meta[1]
}

# Protein intensity matrix (TSV or CSV: proteins in rows, samples in columns)
# (from Spectronaut, DIA-NN, MaxQuant, or directLFQ)
FILE_INTENSITY <- file.path(
  path_data, 
  "directlfq_on_cont_data", 
  "20261008_095241_20260618-1447_Report.tsv.protein_intensities.tsv"
)
if (!file.exists(FILE_INTENSITY)) {
  cand_int <- list.files(path_data, pattern = "(protein.*intensit|pg_matrix|proteinGroups).*\\.(tsv|csv|txt)$", recursive = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(cand_int) > 0) FILE_INTENSITY <- cand_int[1]
}

# Peptide / precursor count file (from the same Spectronaut/DIA-NN run for DEqMS variance modeling)
# (Set to NULL if not available; DEqMS will gracefully fall back to equal weighting)
FILE_PEPTIDES <- file.path(path_data, "20260926_221340_20260618-1447_Report_peptide_numbers.tsv")
if (!file.exists(FILE_PEPTIDES)) {
  cand_pep <- list.files(path_data, pattern = "(peptide.*numbers|pept.*numbers|precursor.*count).*\\.(tsv|csv|txt)$", recursive = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(cand_pep) > 0) {
    FILE_PEPTIDES <- cand_pep[1]
  } else {
    FILE_PEPTIDES <- NULL
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Analysis Parameters & Filters
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata column mappings
PARAM_SAMPLE_ID_COL       <- "Sample_Name" # Column matching sample columns in intensity matrix
PARAM_GROUP_COL           <- "Group"       # Primary factor column defining experimental conditions (e.g. "Group", "Condition")
PARAM_BLOCK_COL           <- NULL          # Optional blocking factor for paired/duplicate correlation (e.g. "Replicate", or NULL)

# Optional cohort subsetting (set to a column name and value, or leave NULL to include all samples)
PARAM_SUBSET_COL          <- NULL          # e.g., "Sex", "Cohort", or NULL
PARAM_SUBSET_VAL          <- NULL          # e.g., "Female", or NULL

# Contrasts to test (leave NULL to auto-generate all pairwise comparisons between group levels)
PARAM_CONTRASTS           <- NULL          # e.g., c("Treated - Control") or NULL

# Quality control & filtering parameters
PARAM_APPLY_SAMPLE_FILTER <- TRUE       # Drop samples failing QC (set FALSE to inspect without dropping)
PARAM_MAX_MISSING_RATE    <- 0.50       # Tier 1: Drop samples with > 50% missing proteins
PARAM_MAD_CUTOFF          <- 3.0        # Tier 1: ID count and sum intensity cutoff (median - 3*MAD)
PARAM_IAC_MAD_CUTOFF      <- 3.0        # Tier 2: Multivariate IAC cutoff (-3 MAD below median IAC)
PARAM_MIN_COMPLETENESS    <- 0.70       # Require protein present in >= 70% in at least 1 group
PARAM_FILTER_CONTAMINANTS <- TRUE       # Remove contaminants matching regex
PARAM_CONTAMINANT_REGEX   <- "^Cont|^CON__"
PARAM_NORM_METHOD         <- "medianCentering" # "medianCentering" or "none"
PARAM_IMPUTE_METHOD       <- "sample_minimum"  # "sample_minimum" or "none"

# Output Excel Workbook
FILE_OUTPUT_XLSX <- file.path(path_results, "Proteomics_DEqMS_Analysis_Results.xlsx")

cat("Configuration successfully initialized.\n")
cat(sprintf("Intensity Matrix: %s\n", if (!is.null(FILE_INTENSITY)) basename(FILE_INTENSITY) else "Not found"))
cat(sprintf("Metadata File:    %s\n", if (!is.null(FILE_METADATA)) basename(FILE_METADATA) else "Not found"))
cat(sprintf("Peptide File:     %s\n", if (!is.null(FILE_PEPTIDES)) basename(FILE_PEPTIDES) else "None (limma eBayes fallback)"))
```

# 2. Metadata Ingestion & Cohort Subsetting

```{r}
#| label: ingest-metadata

# Determine file delimiter and load metadata
meta_delim <- if (grepl("\\.tsv$", FILE_METADATA, ignore.case = TRUE)) "\t" else ","
meta_raw <- read.table(FILE_METADATA, sep = meta_delim, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Ensure sample identifier column exists
if (!PARAM_SAMPLE_ID_COL %in% colnames(meta_raw)) {
  PARAM_SAMPLE_ID_COL <- colnames(meta_raw)[1]
  warning(sprintf("Configured sample ID column not found. Defaulting to first column: '%s'", PARAM_SAMPLE_ID_COL))
}

# Standardize Sample_Name and convert character metadata columns to factors
meta_clean <- meta_raw %>%
  mutate(
    Sample_Name = as.character(.data[[PARAM_SAMPLE_ID_COL]]),
    across(where(is.character), as.factor)
  )

# Define Primary Experimental Group Factor
if (PARAM_GROUP_COL %in% colnames(meta_clean)) {
  meta_clean$Group <- factor(meta_clean[[PARAM_GROUP_COL]])
} else {
  stop(sprintf("Primary group column '%s' not found in metadata. Available columns: %s\nPlease update PARAM_GROUP_COL in Section 1 to match your metadata grouping column.",
               PARAM_GROUP_COL, paste(colnames(meta_clean), collapse = ", ")))
}

# Apply optional cohort filter (e.g. subset by Sex or Cohort)
if (!is.null(PARAM_SUBSET_COL) && !is.null(PARAM_SUBSET_VAL)) {
  if (PARAM_SUBSET_COL %in% colnames(meta_clean)) {
    meta_active <- meta_clean %>%
      filter(.data[[PARAM_SUBSET_COL]] == PARAM_SUBSET_VAL) %>%
      droplevels()
    cat(sprintf("Cohort filtered on %s == '%s': %d samples retained.\n", 
                PARAM_SUBSET_COL, PARAM_SUBSET_VAL, nrow(meta_active)))
  } else {
    warning(sprintf("Subset column '%s' not found. Retaining all samples.", PARAM_SUBSET_COL))
    meta_active <- meta_clean
  }
} else {
  meta_active <- meta_clean
}

cat(sprintf("Loaded metadata for %d active samples across %d experimental groups (%s):\n", 
            nrow(meta_active), nlevels(meta_active$Group), paste(levels(meta_active$Group), collapse = ", ")))

# Cohort summary table
if (!is.null(PARAM_BLOCK_COL) && PARAM_BLOCK_COL %in% colnames(meta_active)) {
  table_summary <- meta_active %>%
    dplyr::count(Group, .data[[PARAM_BLOCK_COL]]) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
} else {
  table_summary <- meta_active %>%
    dplyr::count(Group)
}
print(table_summary)
```

# 3. Protein Quantification Matrix Ingestion

```{r}
#| label: ingest-intensity-matrix

# Load intensity matrix
df_intensities <- read.delim(FILE_INTENSITY, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Extract protein IDs from first column
prot_id_col <- colnames(df_intensities)[1]
protein_identifiers <- df_intensities[[prot_id_col]]
mat_raw <- as.matrix(df_intensities[, -1, drop = FALSE])
rownames(mat_raw) <- protein_identifiers

# Clean Spectronaut / DIA-NN / MaxQuant column headers to match Sample_Name
# Strips run prefixes (e.g. "[1] "), file extensions (.raw, .mzML, .d), and optional project prefixes
colnames(mat_raw) <- colnames(mat_raw) |>
  sub(pattern = "^\\[[0-9]+\\]\\s*", replacement = "") |>
  sub(pattern = "\\.(raw|mzML|d).*", replacement = "") |>
  sub(pattern = ".*ASK_", replacement = "")

# Convert zeros to NAs (unquantified)
mat_raw[mat_raw == 0] <- NA

# Align samples between matrix and metadata
matched_samples <- intersect(meta_active$Sample_Name, colnames(mat_raw))
cat(sprintf("Aligned %d samples between metadata and intensity matrix (out of %d metadata samples).\n",
            length(matched_samples), nrow(meta_active)))

if (length(matched_samples) == 0) {
  cat("\nMetadata Sample_Names (first 5):\n")
  print(head(meta_active$Sample_Name, 5))
  cat("\nIntensity Matrix Column Names (first 5):\n")
  print(head(colnames(mat_raw), 5))
  stop("Zero sample IDs matched between metadata and quantification matrix. Please verify column naming.")
}

# Filter to matched samples
meta_active <- meta_active %>% filter(Sample_Name %in% matched_samples) %>% arrange(Sample_Name)
mat_active  <- mat_raw[, meta_active$Sample_Name, drop = FALSE]

cat(sprintf("Input matrix dimensions: %d proteins x %d samples.\n", nrow(mat_active), ncol(mat_active)))
```

# 4. Quality Control & Sample Filtering

We perform automated, multi-tiered sample quality control using **`filter_proteomics_samples()`**:

1. **Tier 1 (Univariate Metrics)**:
   - **Protein Identification Yield**: Flags samples with ID counts $< \text{Median} - 3 \times \text{MAD}$.
   - **Sample-Level Missingness**: Flags samples with $> 50\%$ missing proteins (`max_missing_rate = 0.50`).
   - **Total Signal Intensity**: Flags samples with $\log_2$ total intensity $< \text{Median} - 3 \times \text{MAD}$.
2. **Tier 2 (Multivariate QC via Inter-Sample Correlation)**:
   - On retained Tier 1 samples, features present in $\ge 70\%$ of samples (`min_feature_completeness = 0.70`) are selected.
   - Pairwise Pearson correlation ($r_{ij}$) across samples is calculated.
   - Mean connectivity $\bar{r}_i$ and robust Z-score $Z_i = \frac{\bar{r}_i - \text{median}}{\text{MAD}}$ are evaluated.
   - Samples with $Z_i < -3$ MADs below the median are flagged as `"Discard (Correlation Outlier)"`.

```{r}
#| label: filter-proteomics-samples-definition

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. filter_proteomics_samples() Definition
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
filter_proteomics_samples <- function(
    mat, 
    group = NULL, 
    mad_cutoff = 3, 
    max_missing_rate = 0.50,
    iac_sd_cutoff = 3,           # Exclude if connectivity is > 3 MADs below median
    min_feature_completeness = 0.70
) {
  sample_names <- colnames(mat)
  n_samples <- length(sample_names)
  
  if (is.null(group)) {
    group <- factor(rep("All", n_samples))
  } else {
    group <- factor(group)
  }
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 1: Univariate Metrics
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  id_counts <- colSums(!is.na(mat))
  missing_rate <- colMeans(is.na(mat))
  
  is_log <- max(mat, na.rm = TRUE) < 100
  if (is_log) {
    sum_intensity <- colSums(2^mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    sum_intensity <- colSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  med_id <- median(id_counts)
  mad_id <- mad(id_counts, constant = 1.4826)
  id_threshold <- med_id - (mad_cutoff * mad_id)
  
  log_sum <- log2(pmax(sum_intensity, 1))
  finite_log_sum <- log_sum[is.finite(log_sum)]
  med_sum <- median(finite_log_sum)
  mad_sum <- mad(finite_log_sum, constant = 1.4826)
  sum_threshold <- med_sum - (mad_cutoff * mad_sum)
  
  tier1_flags <- tibble(
    sample_id = sample_names,
    group = group,
    id_count = id_counts,
    missing_rate = missing_rate,
    sum_intensity = sum_intensity,
    fail_id_mad = id_counts < id_threshold,
    fail_hard_missing = missing_rate > max_missing_rate,
    fail_intensity_mad = coalesce(log_sum < sum_threshold, FALSE)
  ) %>%
    mutate(tier1_drop = fail_id_mad | fail_hard_missing | fail_intensity_mad)
  
  retained_t1 <- tier1_flags %>% filter(!tier1_drop) %>% pull(sample_id)
  dropped_t1 <- tier1_flags %>% filter(tier1_drop) %>% pull(sample_id)
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 2: Multivariate QC via Inter-Sample Correlation (IAC)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  tier2_flags <- tibble(
    sample_id = sample_names,
    mean_iac = NA_real_,
    iac_zscore = NA_real_,
    fail_iac = FALSE
  )
  
  med_iac <- NA_real_
  mad_iac <- NA_real_
  threshold_iac <- NA_real_
  
  if (length(retained_t1) >= 5) {
    sub_mat <- mat[, retained_t1, drop = FALSE]
    if (!is_log) {
      sub_mat <- log2(sub_mat + 1)
    }
    
    # Filter for proteins present across sufficient samples
    feature_present <- rowMeans(!is.na(sub_mat)) >= min_feature_completeness
    iac_input <- sub_mat[feature_present, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # Pairwise complete Pearson correlation matrix
    cor_mat <- cor(iac_input, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Mean correlation of each sample to all other retained samples (excluding self)
    diag(cor_mat) <- NA
    mean_cor <- colMeans(cor_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Robust Z-score of connectivity using median and MAD
    med_iac <- median(mean_cor, na.rm = TRUE)
    mad_iac <- mad(mean_cor, constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE)
    threshold_iac <- med_iac - (iac_sd_cutoff * mad_iac)
    iac_z <- (mean_cor - med_iac) / mad_iac
    
    iac_df <- tibble(
      sample_id = names(mean_cor),
      mean_iac = mean_cor,
      iac_zscore = iac_z,
      fail_iac = iac_z < -iac_sd_cutoff
    )
    
    tier2_flags <- tier2_flags %>%
      rows_update(iac_df, by = "sample_id")
  }
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Summary & Decision Reporting
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  qc_summary <- tier1_flags %>%
    left_join(tier2_flags, by = "sample_id") %>%
    mutate(
      decision = case_when(
        tier1_drop ~ "Discard (Low Yield/Missingness)",
        fail_iac ~ "Discard (Correlation Outlier)",
        TRUE ~ "Keep for Imputation"
      )
    )
  
  final_keep <- qc_summary %>% filter(decision == "Keep for Imputation") %>% pull(sample_id)
  final_discard <- qc_summary %>% filter(decision != "Keep for Imputation") %>% pull(sample_id)
  
  cat("================ QC FILTER REPORT ================\n")
  cat(sprintf("Total input samples: %d\n", n_samples))
  cat(sprintf("Tier 1 cutoffs: Min IDs = %.0f, Max Missing = %.1f%%, Intensity lower log2 = %.2f\n", 
              id_threshold, max_missing_rate * 100, sum_threshold))
  cat(sprintf("Tier 1 removed: %d samples\n", length(dropped_t1)))
  cat(sprintf("Tier 2 removed (IAC Outliers < -%.1f MAD): %d samples\n", iac_sd_cutoff, sum(qc_summary$fail_iac, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("Final retained samples: %d | Final discarded: %d\n", length(final_keep), length(final_discard)))
  cat("==================================================\n\n")
  
  return(list(
    qc_table = qc_summary,
    filtered_matrix = mat[, final_keep, drop = FALSE],
    retained_samples = final_keep,
    discarded_samples = final_discard,
    id_threshold = id_threshold,
    sum_threshold = sum_threshold,
    med_iac = med_iac,
    mad_iac = mad_iac,
    iac_threshold = threshold_iac
  ))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Execute QC on Input Matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
qc_res <- filter_proteomics_samples(
  mat = mat_active,
  group = meta_active$Group,
  mad_cutoff = PARAM_MAD_CUTOFF,
  max_missing_rate = PARAM_MAX_MISSING_RATE,
  iac_sd_cutoff = PARAM_IAC_MAD_CUTOFF,
  min_feature_completeness = PARAM_MIN_COMPLETENESS
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Apply Decision to Downstream Pipeline
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (PARAM_APPLY_SAMPLE_FILTER) {
  mat_qc  <- qc_res$filtered_matrix
  meta_qc <- meta_active %>% filter(Sample_Name %in% qc_res$retained_samples) %>% droplevels()
  cat(sprintf("Active analysis cohort: %d samples retained (%d discarded).\n", 
              ncol(mat_qc), length(qc_res$discarded_samples)))
} else {
  mat_qc  <- mat_active
  meta_qc <- meta_active
  cat(sprintf("PARAM_APPLY_SAMPLE_FILTER is FALSE: Retaining all %d samples for downstream steps.\n", 
              ncol(mat_qc)))
}
```

## Figure: Sample Log2 Intensity Distributions (Boxplot QC)

We plot the intensity distribution of every sample, ordered by its median $\log_2$ intensity, highlighting samples retained for imputation versus those flagged for removal:

```{r}
#| label: fig-qc-intensity-boxplots
#| fig-cap: "Sample Log2 intensity distributions ordered by median intensity, color-coded by QC decision"
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 7

plot_proteomics_qc_boxplots <- function(
    mat, 
    qc_res, 
    highlight_samples = c(), 
    highlight_label = "Flagged / Inspected"
) {
  is_log <- max(mat, na.rm = TRUE) < 100
  plot_mat <- if (is_log) mat else log2(mat + 1)
  
  status_map <- qc_res$qc_table %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, decision)
  
  plot_df <- as.data.frame(plot_mat) %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "protein_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -protein_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2_intensity") %>%
    filter(!is.na(log2_intensity)) %>%
    left_join(status_map, by = "sample_id") %>%
    mutate(
      display_status = case_when(
        sample_id %in% highlight_samples ~ highlight_label,
        decision != "Keep for Imputation" ~ "Discarded (QC Fail)",
        TRUE ~ "Retained"
      ),
      is_highlighted = sample_id %in% highlight_samples,
      sample_id = reorder(sample_id, log2_intensity, FUN = median)
    )
  
  fill_palette <- c(
    "Retained" = "#94A3B8",
    "Discarded (QC Fail)" = "#F87171"
  )
  fill_palette[highlight_label] <- "#F59E0B"
  
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = sample_id, y = log2_intensity)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(fill = display_status, color = is_highlighted, linewidth = is_highlighted),
      outlier.size = 0.35, outlier.alpha = 0.15, notch = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_palette, name = "QC Category") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#334155", "TRUE" = "#000000"), guide = "none") +
    scale_linewidth_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 0.25, "TRUE" = 0.8), guide = "none") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, 
        size = if (ncol(mat) > 80) 5.5 else 8
      ),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Sample Log2 Intensity Distributions",
      subtitle = sprintf("Total: %d | Retained: %d | Discarded: %d", 
                         ncol(mat), length(qc_res$retained_samples), length(qc_res$discarded_samples)),
      x = "Sample (Ordered by Median Log2 Intensity)",
      y = expression(Log[2]~Intensity)
    )
}

print(plot_proteomics_qc_boxplots(mat = mat_active, qc_res = qc_res))
```

## Figure: Multivariate QC via Inter-Sample Correlation (IAC)

Each sample's connectivity (mean pairwise Pearson correlation to all other retained samples) is ranked and plotted against the cohort median and the $-3$ MAD outlier cutoff:

```{r}
#| label: fig-iac-connectivity-dotplot
#| fig-cap: "Sample connectivity (Mean Inter-Sample Correlation) with -3 MAD outlier cutoff"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

p_iac_dot <- ggplot(qc_res$qc_table %>% filter(!is.na(mean_iac)), 
       aes(x = reorder(sample_id, mean_iac), y = mean_iac, color = decision)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = qc_res$med_iac, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = qc_res$iac_threshold, linetype = "dotted", color = "#D62728", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Keep for Imputation" = "#2CA02C", "Discard (Correlation Outlier)" = "#D62728")) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9.5) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6), legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    title = "Sample Connectivity (Mean Inter-Sample Correlation)",
    subtitle = sprintf("Dashed: Median = %.3f | Dotted: -%.1f MAD Cutoff = %.3f | Outliers: %d", 
                       qc_res$med_iac, PARAM_IAC_MAD_CUTOFF, qc_res$iac_threshold, sum(qc_res$qc_table$fail_iac)),
    x = "Sample ID",

    color = "QC Decision"
  )

print(p_iac_dot)
```

# 5. Feature Filtering & Contaminant Removal

```{r}
#| label: filter-proteins

# 1. Group-wise Completeness Filtering
# Keep proteins detected in >= 70% of samples in at least one biological group
filter_proteins_by_group <- function(mat, metadata, group_col = "Group", min_completeness = 0.70) {
  groups <- unique(metadata[[group_col]])
  keep_proteins <- logical(nrow(mat))
  
  for (g in groups) {
    samples_in_g <- metadata %>% filter(.data[[group_col]] == g) %>% pull(Sample_Name)
    samples_in_g <- intersect(samples_in_g, colnames(mat))
    
    if (length(samples_in_g) > 0) {
      sub_mat <- mat[, samples_in_g, drop = FALSE]
      group_completeness <- rowMeans(!is.na(sub_mat))
      keep_proteins <- keep_proteins | (group_completeness >= min_completeness)
    }
  }
  return(mat[keep_proteins, , drop = FALSE])
}

mat_filtered <- filter_proteins_by_group(
  mat = mat_qc,
  metadata = meta_qc,
  group_col = "Group",
  min_completeness = PARAM_MIN_COMPLETENESS
)

# 2. Contaminant Removal
if (PARAM_FILTER_CONTAMINANTS) {
  is_cont <- grepl(rownames(mat_filtered), pattern = PARAM_CONTAMINANT_REGEX)
  mat_filtered <- mat_filtered[!is_cont, , drop = FALSE]
  cat(sprintf("Removed %d contaminant proteins matching '%s'.\n", sum(is_cont), PARAM_CONTAMINANT_REGEX))
}

cat(sprintf("Retained %d high-confidence endogenous proteins after completeness filtering.\n", nrow(mat_filtered)))
```

# 6. Normalization (Median Centering)

```{r}
#| label: normalize-intensities

normalize_matrix <- function(mat, method = c("medianCentering", "none"), log_base = 2) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  
  # Ensure Log2 transformation
  if (max(mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 100) {
    mat <- log((mat + 1), base = log_base)
  }
  
  if (method == "medianCentering") {
    sample_medians <- apply(mat, 2, stats::median, na.rm = TRUE)
    global_median  <- stats::median(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    mat <- base::sweep(mat, 2, sample_medians, FUN = "-") + global_median
  }
  
  return(mat)
}

mat_norm <- normalize_matrix(mat_filtered, method = PARAM_NORM_METHOD)
```

# 9. Extract Peptide / Precursor Counts for DEqMS

`DEqMS` utilizes quantified peptide/precursor ion counts to shrink protein variance according to quantification confidence.

```{r}
#| label: extract-peptide-counts

final_proteins <- rownames(mat_imputed)

if (!is.null(FILE_PEPTIDES) && file.exists(FILE_PEPTIDES)) {
  pep_raw <- read.delim(FILE_PEPTIDES, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  id_col_pep <- colnames(pep_raw)[1]
  rownames(pep_raw) <- pep_raw[[id_col_pep]]
  
  # Standardize column headers matching sample names
  clean_pep_cols <- colnames(pep_raw) |>
    sub(pattern = "^\\[[0-9]+\\]\\s*", replacement = "") |>
    sub(pattern = "\\.(raw|mzML|d).*", replacement = "") |>
    sub(pattern = ".*ASK_", replacement = "") |>
    sub(pattern = "(_peptides|_precursors)$", replacement = "")
  
  colnames(pep_raw) <- clean_pep_cols
  matched_pep_cols <- intersect(meta_qc$Sample_Name, colnames(pep_raw))
  
  if (length(matched_pep_cols) == 0) {
    target_pep_cols  <- paste(meta_qc$Sample_Name, "peptides", sep = "_")
    matched_pep_cols <- intersect(target_pep_cols, colnames(pep_raw))
  }
  
  if (length(matched_pep_cols) > 0) {
    matched_prots <- intersect(final_proteins, rownames(pep_raw))
    sub_pep <- matrix(1, nrow = length(final_proteins), ncol = length(matched_pep_cols),
                      dimnames = list(final_proteins, matched_pep_cols))
    sub_pep[matched_prots, ] <- as.matrix(pep_raw[matched_prots, matched_pep_cols, drop = FALSE])
    
    # Calculate representative precursor/peptide count per protein (max observed across active samples)
    pep_counts <- apply(sub_pep, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
    pep_counts[is.na(pep_counts) | pep_counts < 1] <- 1
    cat(sprintf("Peptide counts mapped for %d proteins from %d samples (Median = %.0f per protein).\n",
                length(matched_prots), length(matched_pep_cols), median(pep_counts)))
  } else {
    warning("Peptide count file loaded, but columns did not match sample names. Defaulting to equal weighting (count = 1).")
    pep_counts <- setNames(rep(1, length(final_proteins)), final_proteins)
  }
} else {
  cat("Peptide count file not specified or found. Defaulting to equal weighting (count = 1; standard limma eBayes).\n")
  pep_counts <- setNames(rep(1, length(final_proteins)), final_proteins)
}

pep_counts <- pep_counts[final_proteins]
cat(sprintf("Peptide counts initialized for %d proteins (Median = %.0f precursors per protein).\n",
            length(pep_counts), median(pep_counts)))
```

# 10. Linear Modeling (limma) & DEqMS Variance Modeling

We construct the design matrix for all experimental conditions, account for technical duplicate runs using `duplicateCorrelation`, fit linear models, and perform DEqMS variance shrinkage.

```{r}
#| label: deqms-modeling

# 1. Design Matrix
# Ensure syntactically valid factor level names for limma makeContrasts
group_levels <- make.names(levels(meta_qc$Group))
levels(meta_qc$Group) <- group_levels

design_mat <- model.matrix(~ 0 + Group, data = meta_qc)
colnames(design_mat) <- levels(meta_qc$Group)

# 2. Estimate Technical Replicate Correlation (Paired Runs / Duplicates)
use_blocks <- !is.null(PARAM_BLOCK_COL) && 
              (PARAM_BLOCK_COL %in% colnames(meta_qc)) && 
              any(duplicated(meta_qc[[PARAM_BLOCK_COL]]))

if (use_blocks) {
  dup_corr <- duplicateCorrelation(
    mat_imputed, 
    design = design_mat, 
    block = meta_qc[[PARAM_BLOCK_COL]]
  )
  cat(sprintf("Consensus duplicate/paired correlation: %.3f\n", dup_corr$consensus.correlation))
  
  # 3. Fit Linear Model with Block Correlation
  fit_lm <- lmFit(
    mat_imputed, 
    design = design_mat, 
    block = meta_qc[[PARAM_BLOCK_COL]], 
    correlation = dup_corr$consensus.correlation
  )
} else {
  cat("No repeated blocking structure detected. Fitting standard limma model.\n")
  fit_lm <- lmFit(mat_imputed, design = design_mat)
}

# 4. Construct Experimental Contrasts
# If PARAM_CONTRASTS is defined in Section 1, use it.
# Otherwise, automatically generate all pairwise comparisons between group levels.
if (!is.null(PARAM_CONTRASTS) && length(PARAM_CONTRASTS) > 0) {
  contrast_formulas <- PARAM_CONTRASTS
} else {
  grps <- colnames(design_mat)
  if (length(grps) >= 2) {
    pw <- combn(grps, 2, simplify = FALSE)
    contrast_formulas <- sapply(pw, function(p) paste0(p[2], " - ", p[1]))
    names(contrast_formulas) <- sapply(pw, function(p) paste0(p[2], "_vs_", p[1]))
  } else {
    stop("At least two experimental groups are required to define differential contrasts.")
  }
}

contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_formulas, levels = design_mat)
cat("Constructed contrasts for differential testing:\n")
print(colnames(contrast_matrix))

fit_contrasts <- contrasts.fit(fit_lm, contrast_matrix)

# 5. DEqMS Variance Shrinkage
fit_contrasts$count <- as.numeric(pep_counts)
fit_contrasts <- eBayes(fit_contrasts)
fit_deqms <- spectraCounteBayes(fit_contrasts)
```

## DEqMS Diagnostic Variance Boxplot

```{r}
#| label: fig-deqms-variance-curve
#| fig-cap: "DEqMS variance shrinkage curve against precursor counts"
VarianceBoxplot(fit_deqms, n = 20, xlab = "Peptide / Precursor Count")
```

# 11. Extract Differential Abundance Results

```{r}
#| label: extract-contrast-results

contrast_cols <- colnames(contrast_matrix)
results_list  <- list()

for (cn in contrast_cols) {
  res_df <- outputResult(fit_deqms, coef_col = cn) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Protein_ID") %>%
    mutate(
      Contrast = cn,
      Significant_FDR05 = !is.na(sca.adj.pval) & sca.adj.pval < 0.05,
      Significant_P05   = !is.na(sca.P.Value) & sca.P.Value < 0.05
    ) %>%
    arrange(sca.adj.pval)
  
  results_list[[cn]] <- res_df
}

# Summary table of significant hits
df_summary_hits <- tibble(
  Contrast = contrast_cols,
  Total_Tested = map_int(results_list, nrow),
  Hits_FDR05   = map_int(results_list, ~ sum(.x$Significant_FDR05)),
  Hits_Nominal = map_int(results_list, ~ sum(.x$Significant_P05))
)

print(df_summary_hits)
```

## Volcano Plots for Experimental Contrasts

```{r}
#| label: fig-volcano-plots
#| fig-cap: "Volcano plots across experimental contrasts"
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

plots_volcano <- list()

for (cn in contrast_cols[1:min(6, length(contrast_cols))]) {
  df_v <- results_list[[cn]] %>%
    mutate(
      Status = case_when(
        Significant_FDR05 & logFC > 0 ~ "Up (FDR < 0.05)",
        Significant_FDR05 & logFC < 0 ~ "Down (FDR < 0.05)",
        Significant_P05               ~ "Nominal p < 0.05",
        TRUE                          ~ "Not Sig"
      )
    )
  
  p_volc <- ggplot(df_v, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(sca.P.Value), color = Status)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Up (FDR < 0.05)"   = "#d73027",
      "Down (FDR < 0.05)" = "#4575b4",
      "Nominal p < 0.05"  = "#fdae61",
      "Not Sig"           = "grey80"
    )) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    labs(
      title = cn,
      subtitle = sprintf("Hits FDR < 0.05: %d", sum(df_v$Significant_FDR05)),
      x = expression(Log[2]~Fold~Change),
      y = expression(-Log[10]~Nominal~p)
    )
  
  plots_volcano[[cn]] <- p_volc
}

wrap_plots(plots_volcano, ncol = 3)
```
